settings.heading: How much does a custom hoodie or sweatshirt cost?
settings.row_content:
The price of your custom printed hoodie or sweatshirt depends on several factors:

  • . Quantity ordered
  • . Number of colors in your design
  • . Number of print locations
  • . Printing method (digital or screen printing)
  • . Most importantly, the specific product you choose

Our sweatshirts range from budget-friendly options to premium styles. Use the quote calculator available on each product page or inside our Design Studio to see how these factors affect your total cost.Don’t forget to check out our money-saving tips to get the best value on your order!

settings.heading: How many sweatshirts do I have to order? Can I order just one?
settings.row_content:
Yes! Any product marked "no minimum" can be ordered in any quantity—even, even just one. These use our digital printing process, which requires no setup and lets you order custom sweatshirts individually.

For screen printed or embroidered products, there is a 12-piece minimum due to the setup involved. To learn more about these printing methods, check out our Screen Printing vs. Digital Printing video.

settings.heading: What’s the difference between screen printing and digital printing?
settings.row_content:
• . Digital printing: No minimum order, unlimited colors, and great for small quantities or complex designs. Available only on products labeled "no minimum."
  • . Screen printing: Requires a minimum of 12 pieces. Pricing depends on the number of colors in your design. It offers significant savings on large orders and can print on nearly any product.

Watch our comparison video to see which printing method fits your needs best.

settings.heading: How long will it take to get my custom sweatshirts?
settings.row_content:
• . Digital printing: Printed and processed within 1-2 days.
  • . Screen printing: Takes about 5-7 days for production.

Shipping takes 1-5 days depending on your location and shipping method. Need it faster? We offer rush options—just contact us!

settings.heading: How should I get started designing my custom hoodie?
settings.row_content:
• . Browse our products to find your preferred style first, then customize it in the Design Studio.
  • . Have a logo or design ready? Upload it directly to the Design Studio and customize your product.
  • . Need inspiration? Check out our Design Templates for professionally crafted, fully customizable designs.

settings.heading: Is there a bulk discount for large orders?
settings.row_content: Yes! The more you order, the bigger the discount. Use the quote calculator on each product page to enter your sizes and quantities and get an instant, all-inclusive price with discounts applied.
